claim: With three workers, one Evergreen trade (12 Wheat for 6 Animal Hide, Glass Pane paused) took 234 to 269 seconds from the store reaching 12 Wheat to the sixth Hide unloading. That is no faster than the one-worker trade (216 to 232 seconds), so extra workers did not visibly speed a trade up.

evidence.reference: Local agent playtest, 27 October 2026: wiki branch codex/playtest-2026-10-27 (commits 95534692 and f272b4b5), docs/INFORMATION-ANSWERS.md there, entry "Evergreen Trading Outpost — three-worker follow-up". Screenshots: gameplay-evidence/trade/ (three-workers, three-workers-wheat9, three-workers-wheat12, three-workers-hides11, three-workers-hides12).

notes: Same Evergreen sandbox, days 42–43, Violet, Nancy and Joshua assigned throughout, normal speed with no pauses. Timestamps: 12 Wheat at 18:31:00.3, 11 Hides at 18:34:54.1, 12 Hides at 18:34:54.5 UTC. One trial each, and the night, farm staffing and hauling differed from the one-worker trial, so this does not prove workers make no difference; it shows no speed-up this time. Elapsed time includes the night and unloading.
